arguments.command:
$tmp="$env:TEMP\hone_wheel_probe"; $venv="$tmp\venv"
python -m venv $venv 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3
& "$venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pip install --no-index --no-deps (Get-ChildItem $tmp\*.whl).FullName 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5
Write-Host "--- import ---"
Push-Location $tmp
& "$venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "import hone; print(hone.__file__); print(hone.Hone)" 2>&1
Pop-Location
arguments.description: Reproduce venv wheel install and import
